name: Yamamura Enishi
source:
"I am Enishi Yamamura. Director of the affiliated hospital at Sagami University. My daughter Yurisa is quite a handful. Who would've thought she'd take a part-time job at a game company!"

Director of Yamamura University Hospital and [url=/c160575]Yurisa's[/url] father. The hospital is doing well, but his relationship with his daughter is rocky. I heard he's known to engage in shady business practices that technically don't break the law.

We'll see what kind of ending awaits for someone like him... Let's hope he improves as a person.

[From [url=https://ifi.games/deathendz/chara/?page=category7&ch=enishi]official website[/url]]
